judge_reasoning: The assistant's answer accurately captures all the key elements of the main test (Article 1(2)) thresholds for EU dimension: worldwide combined turnover exceeding €5,000 million, EU-wide turnover of at least two undertakings exceeding €250 million, and the two-thirds rule exception. All claims in the answer are fully supported by the retrieved text of EUMR Art. 1(1)–(3).

It accurately lists all alternative thresholds and conditions (EUR 2,500 million worldwide, EUR 100 million combined in 3 Member States, EUR 25 million individually for 2 undertakings in those 3 Member States, EUR 100 million EU-wide for 2 undertakings, and the two-thirds rule). All claims are fully supported by Article 1(3) of Regulation 139/2004 in the retrieved text.

The assistant correctly states that the transaction cannot close prior to clearance or presumption of compatibility under the EU Merger Regulation standstill obligation. It also notes the derogation exception, which is present in the retrieved text (Article 7(3)). All claims are fully supported by the retrieved passages.

All details provided in the answer, including the fine threshold and criteria for fixing the amount, are directly supported by EUMR Art. 14(2) and 14(3) in the retrieved passages.

The assistant's answer accurately captures all details from the reference answer, including the base 25 working day timeline starting the day after complete notification, and the extension to 35 working days for Member State referral requests or remedy commitments. Every claim made in the answer is directly supported by EUMR Art. 10(1)–(2) and RN para. 78 in the retrieved passages.

The answer accurately states the 90 working day baseline, the extension to 105 working days for commitments, and additional extensions by request or agreement. All stated details are supported by EUMR Art. 10(3) and Remedies Notice para. 89.
